headline: Russian Cargo Ship Sparta II Towed Away After Gulf of Finland Drone Strike
summary: Russian cargo vessel Sparta II was towed after being struck by a drone in the Gulf of Finland while en route to Kaliningrad, sparking a shipboard fire before drifting into Finnish waters.
why: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Baltic Sea escalate maritime transit risk premia and insurance rates across northern European waters.

impacts.name: Baltic Shipping
impacts.why: Drone attacks against merchant shipping elevate freight and war risk insurance in Baltic waters.
